text_block_list.text: Air Groove's three-year "challenge" has finally reached its conclusion—
Reigning supreme as the overwhelming "Empress" and leaving behind such glorious feats... she has now become the target every Umamusume strives to defeat.

Yet she—
has no intention of sitting idly and waiting for that challenge.

"Because she, too...
will always remain a 'challenger.'"

And so the days rolled by...
Her spirit of challenge living on in those who followed—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner and into the home stretch—
Mejiro Dober makes an early bid for the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Dober is holding her ground! Oh! They're neck and neck, side by side!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober from the inside, Mejiro Dober!
Mejiro Dober claims victory in this race!
(WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Female Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mejiro Dober-san!
That was a wonderful race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However... I'm not satisfied just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because there is a goal...
an "ideal" I wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Female Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
An ideal to surpass...!
C-Could that be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... am going to challenge
Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: In the next... Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
(WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you serious?! Doesn't this basically
make it a showdown between the new and old queens!?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~!
I don't know who to cheer for~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That's it, Dober.
Come on up...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Of course.
Nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as Dober once told me—
she is trying to take on the challenge, after all.

Leaving the racecourse behind,
Air Groove and I took a slight detour on our way back.

Along the way, we talked and looked back on
the path we had walked together so far.

Come to think of it, Air Groove and I
might not have talked much about past memories before.

"Because she is someone...
who always looks forward."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It is not just Dober.
Everyone strives each day to challenge me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In order to keep guiding them going forward...
I must continue to reign as the "Empress"
as long as I am an active competitor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...And for that, Trainer.
I need you."
choice_data_list: I'll follow you to the ends of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Now, let me ask you once again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In your eyes—how do I appear?

The answer is already decided.
Air Groove, to everyone, is—
And that is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then with all my might,
I shall continue to answer your "ideals."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You are—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because you are my "ideal" Trainer.
